citations.claim: EW yellow starts, should last 6s to step 190
last yellow second, only 4th yellow step
first violating step: EW red after only 4s yellow, violates yellow_duration limit 6

counterfactual.change: actuated true -> false (single field change to fixed-time cycle); eliminates actuated recall preemption of yellow, so yellow runs full 6s and no violation

explanation: Shrunk actuated scenario with yellow_seconds=6 shows EW yellow truncated to 4s. EW was green at step 183 then yellow 184-187 (4 steps) then all-red at 188, while NS wait=67 with large queues (27/21) triggers actuated recall. Controller's actuated/recall logic preempts yellow early to service waiting direction instead of letting yellow run full 6s. Fixed-time (actuated=false) with identical timings removes preemption and violation disappears, confirming actuated yellow interruption as cause.
vision_note: Steps 185-187 show the east-west approaches with yellow signals while north-south remain red. At step 188 all four approaches are suddenly red, so the yellow phase visibly ends after only four seconds instead of holding the required six seconds before going to all-red.
